Happy 25th birthday,

Zimbini

Five candles, one for every birthday we've shared. Make a wish, then tap each one to blow it out.

Our story so far

A few of our moments, and a few of yours.

07

And now, there are three of us.

You carried our little one with so much strength and grace. Our biggest adventure yet, and there's no one I'd rather take it with.

Now the serious love things and stuff…

Well, this is it. Finally 25, and I can't believe I've witnessed your birthdays ever since you turned 21. It feels surreal. One day you just meet a stranger at the school library, take them out for ice cream, and they turn out to be the best decision you have ever made in your life. There was very little chance of our paths actually crossing, but boy am I glad that I went to campus that day.

This is the 5th birthday I'm witnessing with you, and the more things change, the more they stay the same. You're still the same beautiful, smart, kind girl I fell in love with that day at the library, and yet you've changed so much. You've learnt so many things, grown so much, achieved so much, and I'm just grateful to have been a part of your journey and to have had you as part of mine. You've seen me through my darkest nights, the happy ones, and the ones where you struggled to recognise me and still chose me.

I can't even begin to express how grateful I am for you, Zimbini, because I wouldn't know where to start if I tried. Thank you for being an amazing friend and an amazing partner.

As you start this new journey and navigate your big girl age, I need you to do a couple of things for me.

  1. I need you to start giving yourself credit for being the hardworking person you are, even when you don't see it. You're one of the hardest working people I know, baby, and in the moments where you feel like you're not working hard enough, turn to me and I'll remind you just how hard you've worked.
  2. I need you to be content and satisfied with what you've achieved and where you are in life. You're doing the best you can with what you have, and that's good enough.
  3. I need you to always remember that you are enough. You never have to live with the fear of not being enough or not being adequate. Even when you don't try, just by being yourself, you are enough.
  4. When things get heavy, during your darkest nights, I need you to always know that you don't have to do it alone. You don't have to carry the weight by yourself. Lean on me. I'll always be there to share your load. That's what companionship is.
  5. I need you to know that you are loved, more than your heart and mind can ever comprehend. Even in moments where you don't feel it, in moments where I don't say it, I love you, even in silence. You have a very special place in my heart, Zimbini.

And this year is your first birthday as a mum. Watching you become one has been the most beautiful thing I've ever seen. The late nights, the early feeds, the way you still find a smile for both of us when you're running on almost nothing. I don't say it enough, so I'm saying it here: I see all of it, and I'm in awe of you.

You gave me the best gift of my life, and somehow you're still the best part of my day.

As much as your birthday this year includes changing nappies and looking after that mini me, I want you to know we'll make up for it once the timing is right. And when we do, you'll have the time of your life.

I'm counting down the days until the 17th, when you're home again. The house is far too quiet without you.

I love you. Happy birthday.

Khathu

You always ask me why I love you, at least once every two weeks. Well, let's see…
